    USED Sony A7 III Digital Camera Body

    The Sony A7 III Digital Camera Body is the third iteration in the game-changing Sony A7 range. It comes upgraded with a back-illuminated 24.2-megapixel Full-Frame Exmor R CMOS imaging sensor, and the reinvented BIONZ X processing engine. The camera facilitates 4K HDR video capture and comes with 15-stops of dynamic range. Furthermore, it is capable of shooting 10fps, offers a fantastic ISO from 100-51200 as well as 5-axis image stabilisation all in a stylish, compact mirrorless system camera body.

    Sony A7 III Digital Camera Body Key Features:
    • Features a back-illuminated 24.2-megapixel Full-Frame Exmor R CMOS image sensor
    • Capture stunning detail in both highlights and shadows thanks to the 15-stops of dynamic range
    • Generous ISO range from 100-51200 that can be expanded to 50-204800 thanks to which low-light capture with minimal noise is possible
    • Offers 14-bit RAW capture that works well in silent and continuous shooting scenarios
    • The incorporated 5-axis 5-step image stabilisation system supports smooth handheld shooting at lower shutter speeds
    • This model includes a generous 693 phase-detection, and 425 contrast detection AF points
    • Twice as fast AF system due to the introduction of focal-plane phase-detection technology
    • Advanced AF tracking facilitates precise focus outcomes when working with video and continuous/burst modes that feature moving subjects
    • AF/AE tracking allows for 10fps continuous burst shooting or 8fps burst shooting in Live View mode
    • Touch Focus and Touch Pad functions allow users to simply tap on the rear screen to locate the focus. Alternatively, the focus frame can be dragged across the shot when utilising the viewfinder.
    • Users can enjoy outstanding 4K High Dynamic Range video capture without pixel binning
    • The newly incorporated Hybrid Log-Gamma provides greater flexibility during post-production workflows
    • Compatible with the high-capacity NP-FZ100 battery a perk not available in previous models
    • Shoot up to 710 images on one battery charge
    • Includes dual media slots with UHS-II support

    For more information or a detailed specifications list, visit the Sony website here.

    Expanded Sony A7 III Digital Camera Body Key Features:

    Revolutionary Eye AF

    The Eye AF can now be used in conjunction with the AF-C mode to deliver fast and effective eye detection and tracking. Ideal for still photography, this easy-maintenance optimum focus works wonders on moving subjects. It has forever revolutionised the way portraiture is shot. The Eye AF works even if the face is partially obscured, when the subject is looking down, and when the subject is backlit making it perfect for all occasions.

    Incredible High-Resolution 4K HDR

    The Mark III features 2.4-times higher oversampling for exceptionally true-to-life 4K movies. The newly implemented Hybrid Log-Gamma picture profile warrants instantaneous HDR workflow. Thanks to the full-pixel readout with absolutely no binning in the 35mm Full-Frame mode minimise moiré and jaggies. Other benefits such as the Fast Hybrid AF with focal-plane phase-detection AF and contrast-detection AF deliver smooth subject tracking for video capture. The user has improved freedom of matching the focus response to a particular scene whether it requires slow motion or high-octane action. Additionally, the AF/AE tracking is fundamentally silent which is ideal for wildlife recording for both still and moving image.

    Exceptionally Gorgeous Low-Light Imagery

    Area-specific Noise Reduction amalgamated with Detail Reproduction technologies preserve beautiful details in images while reducing unwanted noise. The ISO range has been generously extended to ISO 100-51200 and is further expandable to ISO 50-204800 for still images. Thanks to the outstanding performance in the mid-to-high sensitivity range, the Sony A7 Mark III produces an abundance of details in images taken in low-lit conditions.

    Sony A7 III | Hands-On First Look

    Walkthrough & Set Up | The Sony A7 III

    Are you eligible for finance?

    In order to apply you must fulfill the following criteria:

    • Be at least 18 years old
    • Be in full-time work (16 hours or more a week), retired, or in receipt of disability allowance
    • Earn at least £6,000 a year
    • Have been a UK resident for three years or more
    • Have a mobile phone number
    • Have an email address
    • Have a UK bank account from which Direct Debits can be taken
    • Have no outstanding County Court Judgements (CCJs)
    • Channel Island customers, please call us to apply for finance

    All applicants will be subject to a credit reference check by the lender.

    Credit is subject to application and status. Warehouse Express Ltd trading as Wex Photo Video act as credit broker and not the lender. Novuna Consumer Finance act as the lender.

    How does it work?

    Where a qualifying product is added to your basket, the full value of your basket, including any accessories purchases, will be eligible for interest free credit. This is subject to the value of the additional products not exceeding the value of the qualifying product. No deposit is required and payments will be collected by direct debit in monthly instalments, the first instalment being collected 30 days after shipment of the product.

    What will I receive from the finance provider (lender)?

    Novuna Consumer Finance will send a loan agreement pack approximately four weeks after delivery of the goods, confirming that the account has been activated and, from this point, it is possible to make repayments against the loan.
